Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of this bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
25 of 2023 at Police Station Baleni, District Baghpat under Section 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in jail since 15.02.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 08.08.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Sunil Kumar Singh, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted Shri Dharmendra Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the informant and Shri Shrawan Kumar Dubey, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:

sentences.text: 1. The applicant is the husband of the deceased.
2. The applicant did not torture the deceased nor did he demand dowry.
3. The deceased was forced to marry her husband against her wishes by the family members of the latter.
4. The victim had another love interest with whom she had a regular telephonic contact even after her marriage.
5. The deceased was depressed on account of the family opposition and failure of her relationship with her love interest to materialize.
6. On the fateful day, the deceased succumbed to depression and took the extreme step of ending her life.
She committed suicide by hanging.
7. The postmortem report opines the cause of death as asphyxia due to antemortem hanging.

8. Injuries depicted in the postmortem report consistent with hanging are:
(i) Nature of ligature mark.
(ii).
The hyoid bone was intact.
9. The applicant did not aid or abet the suicide.
10. The prerequisite for attracting the presumption and the reversing the burden of proof are not established in the facts and circumstances and evidence of the case.
11. Prosecution evidence does not connect the applicant with the offence.
12. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
13. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of her influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Rohit @ Jyoti be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.
The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
